metadata.description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills

readmeSignals.title: skills
readmeSignals.summary: The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. Supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and supported-agents. Generate a prompt for one skill, or start a supported coding agent interactively: skills use resolves sources the same way as skills add, writes the selected skill files to a temporary directory, and prints only the generated prompt to stdout unless --agent is provided. With --agent, it starts one supported agent interactively with the generated prompt. Use the same command for public and private repositories. The CLI uses the authentication already configured for the repository URL:
